title: The Dirichlet Divisor Problem
statement_plain: Let D(x) = sum_{n <= x} d(n) be the summatory divisor function and Delta(x) = D(x) - x log x - (2 gamma - 1) x be the error term. Determine the infimum theta of all exponents alpha such that Delta(x) = O(x^alpha); the Dirichlet divisor conjecture asserts that theta = 1/4 (i.e., Delta(x) = O_eps(x^{1/4 + eps}) for all eps > 0).
